name: ipf-os
title: iPF OS
description: Raise, track, and action iPF OS tickets without leaving your keyboard.
author: joseph_emmanuel

commands.name: search-tickets
commands.title: Search Tickets
commands.subtitle: iPF OS
commands.description: Find any ticket and act on it. Opens on what you are watching, and widens to the whole organisation.

commands.name: create-ticket
commands.title: Create Ticket
commands.subtitle: iPF OS
commands.description: Raise a ticket and route it to the right department, project, or person.

commands.name: assigned-tickets
commands.title: Assigned Tickets
commands.subtitle: iPF OS
commands.description: Keeps a count of the open tickets assigned to you in the menu bar, overdue ones first.

preferences.name: baseUrl
preferences.title: API Gateway
preferences.description: iPF OS gateway, including the /api/v1 path.

preferences.name: webAppUrl
preferences.title: Web App
preferences.description: Where Connect and Open in iPF OS send you.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
